locationWeb._source: docs/tech/F02-map-location-spike.md section 4 row 'ค่า Web' (ค่าแนะนำเริ่มต้น true, 15000, 0)

The tech note wrote timeoutMs/maximumAgeMs; renamed to the unit-suffix convention (ADR 0001 3.10). maximumAge_ms 0 = never accept a cached fix

providerQuery._source: docs/tech/F02-map-location-spike.md section 3 (query loc, trace, speed, loop, hud; ค่าเริ่มต้นต่อ environment มาจาก client config; ค่าที่ไม่รู้จัก → ใช้ค่าเริ่มต้นและเตือนใน console)
providerQuery._note: capacitor is selectable but the stub reports not-implemented (tests the error path). traceWhenUnset: first trace of the import.meta.glob list (gps-trace-format section 5) that passes validateTrace. Boolean params use '1'/'0' in the URL. `start` and `seed` (F04-dungeon-presence.md section 17 test hooks) are read only when `loc=mock`: `start` sets the game clock's replay-start instant (integer epoch ms, or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` interpreted with `config/balance/dungeons.json#openingHours.utcOffset_min`, read via config/balance.ts); `seed` sets the uint32 RNG `runSeed` for every run started on that page load. Both are silently ignored outside `loc=mock` (Web always uses the real clock and `crypto.getRandomValues`, ADR 0003 section 6)

providerQueryDefaultsByMode._note: Keyed by Vite import.meta.env.MODE. 'production' covers vite build, i.e. the Cloudflare Pages preview and the field-walk build. An unknown MODE falls back to 'production' with a console warning (safer: real GPS, HUD off). speedMult (renamed from speed, tech-lead/config-lint) is the Mock playback-speed multiplier default; the URL query param itself is still named `speed` (providerQuery.paramNames.speed) and is unaffected by this rename
providerQueryDefaultsByMode._assumption: A-P1-H05-1: the tech note gives no default for speed or loop. speedMult 1 (real time) everywhere; loop on in development so a demo keeps moving, off in production where mock is only used on purpose. Owner: tech-lead

hudMeasurement._note: Spike measurements only, never sent to a server and never a reward. The gate window length, distance and comparison are read from dungeons.json#movementGate (single source); the TTFF threshold from anticheat.json. Changing these values after the field walk starts breaks comparability with the pre-set criteria in tech note section 10 (TL-M04)

engine._source: ADR 0003 section 3.2 item 5 (client sets a timer, e.g. every 1 second, and on return from page-hidden, and calls sessionStep with a `tick` input; the reducer itself has no timer)
engine._note: The `start` query test hook's YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm form (docs/tech/F04-dungeon-presence.md section 17) is interpreted with balance.dungeons.json#openingHours.utcOffset_min (Bangkok has no DST), read via config/balance.ts — not duplicated here.

storage._source: docs/tech/F04-dungeon-presence.md section 10.1 (client writes kw.p2.session no more often than this, plus immediately on any event, plus on visibilitychange hidden / pagehide)
storage._note: Throttle only: a step that returns at least one event (tick, transition, run end) is still persisted immediately regardless of this interval (10.1). Not a reward value: only changes how much of the last few seconds could be lost if the tab is killed before a write (10.1: 'ไม่มีทางได้รางวัลเกินจริง').

probe._source: P2-F04-T10 (GDD > F-17: Wake Lock + pocket screen, vibrate/web push matrix). No spec gives a vibration length; a short, noticeable single pulse for a manual HUD test button, not a gameplay cue (those are sound-designer/vfx-animator owned, Phase 2 F06)
probe._note: apps/client/src/debug/vibrate.ts's triggerVibrate(navigator, pattern_ms) argument for the HUD's 'Test vibrate' button only. iOS Safari has no navigator.vibrate at all (D-003): the HUD reports 'unsupported' instead of throwing.
probe._assumption: A-P2-F04-T10-1: 200 ms chosen as a short, single, clearly-felt pulse for a manual dev/QA probe (not tuned against a real device yet, P2-C02/P2-F04-T11). Owner: gameplay-programmer

vibration._source: P2-F04-T21 (design/ux/flows/F04-dungeon-presence.md Flow D1 'สั่นหนึ่งครั้งตอนเข้า lock' and section 6 'สั่น 1 ครั้ง' for the closing-soon warning). Neither flow gives an exact pattern length — a single short pulse, not a gameplay hit cue (sound-designer/vfx-animator own those in F06).
vibration._note: apps/client/src/f04-app.ts's only two vibrate() call sites outside the HUD probe (client.json#probe.vibrateTestPattern_ms, a different button for a different purpose).
vibration._assumption: A-P2-F04-T21-1: 200 ms reuses the probe's already-approved single-pulse length rather than inventing a new untuned number; revisit once a real-device pass (P2-C03) or an art/vfx brief gives a designed pattern. Owner: gameplay-programmer

bundle._source: ADR 0003 section 10 (N-13): JS-transfer budgets measured from apps/client/dist's Vite manifest by apps/client/scripts/measure-bundle.ts, brotli quality 11, same method for both keys.
bundle._note: initialJsBudget_bytes covers the entry chunk + every chunk it statically imports (S5 <= 1.0 MB, 10^6 byte) — never maplibre-gl, which main.ts only reaches through await import(...) once hasRuntimeMapEnv(env) is true (P2-F04-T10 code-split). mapLazyJsBudget_bytes covers that lazy maplibre-gl + worker chunk group on its own, measured the same way. CSS/font/tile/trace bytes are excluded from both (ADR 0003 10.4). CI (P2-F06-T16) fails the build when either is exceeded.
bundle._assumption: A-P2-F04-T10-2: this task's own `pnpm build` + `apps/client/scripts/measure-bundle.ts` measured the entry chunk (post code-split) at 48,303 B brotli and the maplibre-gl + worker lazy group at 350,208 B brotli. initialJsBudget_bytes keeps the S5 <= 1.0 MB ceiling from ADR 0003 unchanged (measured value is well under it already); mapLazyJsBudget_bytes is set to 700,000 B (about 2x the measured 350,208 B) for headroom before P2-F06 adds more map layers/assets, not tuned against a real device yet (revisit once P2-C03's real-device numbers land). Owner: gameplay-programmer, tech-lead
